expectations.text: Output explains that a paired t-test is mathematically equivalent to a two-level MLM of the form lmer(score ~ condition + (1 + condition | subject)) for complete, balanced data
expectations.evidence: The response claims equivalence but specifies the wrong MLM: it uses `lmer(score ~ condition + (1|id))` (random intercepts only, compound symmetry assumption) rather than the random-intercept-plus-slope form `(1 + condition | subject)`. The paired t-test is most directly equivalent to the latter (unstructured covariance), not the former. This is a substantive misspecification.
